final:
upper_all(xs: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex upper_all(["a", "b"]) == ["A", "B"]
  var r: List[str] = []
  for s in xs
    r.append(s.upper())
  r

shout(xs: List[str]) uses io =
  pre xs.len() >= 0
  ex shout([]) == ()
  for s in xs
    io.print(s.upper())
